tools.name: get_mewboard_guide
tools.description: What Mewboard can do and which tool does what, with typical requests. Read it when unsure how to do something.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects with issue counts per status. A sub-project has parent_id and path (its parents, from the top). with_money: true adds each project's money (budget total, received, to_receive in its currency, with its sub-projects, plus the sums of its number / money fields), the same numbers peopl

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project by key (e.g. "WEB") or id, with the list of files attached to the project itself (its Overview). To read the description, comments and the CONTENT of those files use read_project.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project. Issues get identifiers like KEY-1. key is derived from the name if omitted. Give it an `icon`: ONE emoji that fits what the project is about (🛒 online shop, 📱 mobile app, 🌐 website, 🤖 bot, 📣 marketing, 🎨 design, 🎬 video, 🎓 course, 🧾 invoicing/finance, 🏗️ construction...),

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update project name/description/status/dates. Changing key renames every issue identifier (WEB-12 -> NEW-12).

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List/filter issues. status may be comma-separated (e.g. "todo,in_progress"): kinds, or names of the project's own statuses.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get an issue (by identifier like WEB-12 or id) including its attachment list and checklists with item ids (no comments or file contents).

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue (task) in a project. Description supports Markdown.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an issue: change status (move on the board), priority, assignee, labels, milestone, title or description. Pass milestone_id "" to clear. due_date (YYYY-MM-DD) sets the deadline.

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.description: Delete an issue: it moves to the trash with its comments and attachments and is erased for good when the trash period of the server ends (14 days by default; it can be restored in the web app until then).

tools.name: add_checklist
tools.description: Add a named checklist to an issue. Optionally give the item texts to create with it. Returns the checklist with item ids.

tools.name: add_checklist_item
tools.description: Add one item to an existing checklist (use the checklist id from get_issue / read_issue).

tools.name: update_checklist_item
tools.description: Tick or untick a checklist item (done true/false) and/or change its text.

tools.name: delete_checklist
tools.description: Delete a whole checklist with its items.

tools.name: set_project_statuses
tools.description: Give a project its own statuses (board columns), e.g. for a shop: New order, Paid, Packing, Shipped, Delivered, Returned. Each status is one of 6 kinds (backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, done, canceled): the kind decides what counts as open, done or canceled. The list REPLACES the current one i

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: What is new FOR ME: changes by other people (or their agents) in the issues I follow, @mentions, assignments and my reminders, newest first. unread_only = only what I have not read yet. Read them with read_issue; mark_notifications_read clears the unread count.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark all my notifications as read (the bell count goes to zero).

tools.name: follow_issue
tools.description: Follow an issue: hear about its comments, status and due date changes, checklists and files.

tools.name: unfollow_issue
tools.description: Stop following an issue (an @mention or a new comment of yours makes you follow it again).

tools.name: list_following
tools.description: The issues I follow in this workspace (newest change first) and why: author, assignee, comment, mention or follow.

tools.name: set_project_notifications
tools.description: How much I hear about a project: all (every change and every new issue), mine (only the issues I follow; the default) or mute (only @mentions).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List the own templates of the workspace: kind project (start a project from it with create_project template) or workspace (offered when a new workspace is created in the app).

tools.name: save_project_as_template
tools.description: Save a project as a template of the workspace: its statuses, custom fields, milestones and (unless issues=false) its open issues with their checklists, unticked, and (unless subprojects=false) its sub-projects. People, comments, files, clients and field values are not kept; dates stay relative to to

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Read one own template of the workspace with all its projects, statuses, fields, milestones, starter tasks and checklists (see list_templates for ids). A template is { name, projects: [project] } (a project template has exactly one project). project = { name, key?, icon? (one emoji), desc?, start?/en

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create an own template of the workspace from scratch, e.g. a project template for a kind of client work with its board columns, fields and starter tasks. kind project (default) or workspace (administrators). A template is { name, projects: [project] } (a project template has exactly one project). pr

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Replace the content of an own template (its author or an administrator): name and/or the whole list of projects. Read it first with get_template, change it, send it back. A template is { name, projects: [project] } (a project template has exactly one project). project = { name, key?, icon? (one emoj

tools.name: list_trash
tools.description: Issues (and projects) in the trash, restorable for a while (14 days by default).

tools.name: restore_issue
tools.description: Bring an issue back from the trash (see list_trash).

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of a project (name, type, options, currency of money fields, formula of formula fields). Their values are set with fields: { "Field name": value } on create_issue / update_issue and shown by get_issue / read_issue.

tools.name: create_field
tools.description: Add a custom field to a project, e.g. Price (money, UAH), Hours (number), Platform (select), Client contact (text). Types: text, number, money (an amount in the field's currency; values are plain numbers, "12 000,50" is read too), date, select (one option), multi (several options), url, person (a me

tools.name: update_field
tools.description: Rename a custom field (formulas that use it follow), change its options, its formula, the currency of a money or formula field (amounts stay as they are) or whether it shows on cards (the type cannot change).

tools.name: try_formula
tools.description: Try a formula on the newest issues of a project before saving it as a formula field: returns each issue's result, or the mistake in the formula. FORMULA language: fields by name in curly braces {Price}; numbers, "text", true/false; + - * / % (date + days, date - date = days), & joins text; = != < <=

tools.name: delete_field
tools.description: Delete a custom field of a project together with its values in every issue.

tools.name: list_milestones
tools.description: List milestones of a project with progress (issue_done / issue_total).

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List the members of the workspace (people and agent accounts) an issue can be assigned to. Use their name as `assignee`, or "me".

tools.name: get_project_totals
tools.description: The money of a project (sub-projects included unless subprojects=false): the total of every number / money / payments / numeric formula field (summed by field name, other currencies converted at today's National Bank of Ukraine rate; done and open; payments received and expected) and the budget: agr

tools.name: get_client_totals
tools.description: The money of all projects of a client: per project (see get_project_totals) and the totals of the fields across them. Use it for "how much does this client owe us?".

tools.name: import_issues
tools.description: Create many issues of one project at once (up to 2000), e.g. a list or a payment history moved from a spreadsheet or another CRM. New fields can be created in the same call. Rows that fail are reported (row, title, error) while the others are created.

tools.name: get_money_report
tools.description: The money report of the workspace, from the payments fields of every project you can see: received, expenses (negative payments), net, expected and overdue money; by month, by project and by client; and every payment (date, issue, client, amount, converted value, received or expected). Each payment

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: List the clients of the workspace (the people or companies projects are for) with their projects and the number of open issues.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Create a client (a person or company). Only name is required. Then give projects or issues a `client`.

tools.name: update_client
tools.description: Update a client (name, company, email, phone, notes). client = its name or id.

tools.name: delete_client
tools.description: Delete a client. Its projects and issues are kept and just lose the client link.

tools.name: create_milestone
tools.description: Create a milestone in a project.

tools.name: update_milestone
tools.description: Update a milestone: rename it, change its description, target date or status (planned, in_progress, done). Its issues stay as they are.

tools.name: delete_milestone
tools.description: Delete a milestone (its issues stay, unassigned).

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on an issue (issue=WEB-12) or on a project (project=WEB), with their attachment metadata.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a Markdown comment to an issue or to a project (give exactly one of issue/project).

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Edit a comment body and / or pin it (pinned: true) or unpin it (false). Pinned comments are shown in a bar at the top of the issue (or project) discussion; list_comments and read_issue mark them.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment of an issue or project for good, with the files attached to it. Use update_comment to change the text instead.

tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Create a questionnaire for a client in a project (platform owner only). Give `markdown` (headings = sections, numbered lines = questions, indented "- " lines under a question = its options, "- [ ]" = multiple choice, trailing * = required) or a `questions` list. Returns the form with `url`: send tha

tools.name: update_form
tools.description: Edit a questionnaire: title, description, thanks message, task, questions (list or markdown), status open/closed, or regenerate=true for a new link (the old one stops working).

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List the questionnaires of a project with their links and answer counts (platform owner only).

tools.name: list_form_responses
tools.description: Read the answers clients sent to a questionnaire: the form with its questions, and every response keyed by question id (platform owner only).

tools.name: attach_file
tools.description: Upload a file and attach it to an issue, project, or comment. Send the file content as base64 in content_base64 (up to 25 MB). Returns `markdown` (a ready relative link such as ![name](/api/files/<id>)): paste exactly that into the issue/comment/description text.

tools.name: read_issue
tools.description: READ EVERYTHING about an issue in one call: fields, full description, ALL comments, and the content of ALL files — attached to the issue, attached to comments, or linked in Markdown. Images come back as viewable images, text/JSON/CSV files inline, PDFs as text plus their first pages as images (scans

tools.name: read_project
tools.description: READ EVERYTHING about a project in one call: description, ALL project-level comments, and the content of ALL files attached to the project, its comments, or linked in Markdown (same output format as read_issue). Does not include the issues of the project.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read ONE attachment. Images are returned as images; text/JSON/CSV/Markdown files as text; PDFs as text plus page images; Word/Excel/PowerPoint/OpenDocument/EPUB as text plus embedded pictures; zip archives as a content listing + local path; other files (video, audio, huge images, legacy .doc/.xls/.p

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List attachments of an issue, of a project (the files on the project Overview, not those of its issues) or of a comment.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.description: Remind a person about an issue, a project or a comment at a time. It is delivered to the channels that person switched on (the bell in Mewboard, email, Telegram). Give exactly one target (issue, project or comment_id) and the time as `at` (ISO 8601 with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-20T09:00:00+03:00) or

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List the reminders of the token owner (pending, and the ones that fired in the last 7 days). Optionally for one issue or project; status: open (default), pending or all.

tools.name: delete_reminder
tools.description: Cancel (delete) a reminder of the token owner.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List the change history as batches, newest first: who changed what (issue fields, created / trashed / restored issues, added / edited / deleted comments), grouped into batches (changes by one person or agent less than 2 minutes apart). Each change has an id, the old and new value and whether it was

tools.name: undo_changes
tools.description: Undo a whole batch (give batch = the batch id from list_changes) or selected changes (change_ids). Safe by default: a field is put back only if it still has the value that change set; anything changed afterwards is left alone and listed as skipped (reason changed_since / gone / already_undone / not_

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text-ish search over issue titles/descriptions and projects.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_projects, get_project, create_project, list_issues, get_issue, set_project_statuses, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, list_following, save_project_as_template, get_template, update_template, list_trash, create_field, list_members, import_issues, get_money_report, list_clients, list_comments, create_form, update_form, read_issue, read_project, read_attachment, list_attachments, list_reminders, list_changes, search · Private data: get_project, get_issue, follow_issue, save_project_as_template, create_field, delete_comment, attach_file, read_issue, read_project, read_attachment, list_attachments, create_reminder, list_reminders, delete_reminder · Public sink: create_issue, update_template, update_client, create_form, attach_file, create_reminder · Destructive: delete_issue, delete_checklist, delete_field, delete_client, delete_milestone, delete_comment, read_project, delete_attachment, delete_reminder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_projects, get_project, create_project, list_issues, get_issue, set_project_statuses, list_notifications, mark_notifications_read, list_following, save_project_as_template, get_template, update_template, list_trash, create_field, list_members, import_issues, get_money_report, list_clients, list_comments, create_form, update_form, read_issue, read_project, read_attachment, list_attachments, list_reminders, list_changes, search · Private data: get_project, get_issue, follow_issue, save_project_as_template, create_field, delete_comment, attach_file, read_issue, read_project, read_attachment, list_attachments, create_reminder, list_reminders, delete_reminder · Public sink: create_issue, update_template, update_client, create_form, attach_file, create_reminder · Destructive: delete_issue, delete_checklist, delete_field, delete_client, delete_milestone, delete_comment, read_project, delete_attachment, delete_reminder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "update_milestone" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Update a milestone." → after: "Update a milestone: rename it, change its description, target date or status (planned, in_progress, done). Its issues stay as they are."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
